services.name: Admission
services.desc: After you purchase, print out the confirmation email or show it to the volunteers to check-in. Redeemable during any regular museum hours. Also redeemable for appointment-based admissions. Pre-paid admission valid for regular visits only. Not valid for special events, lectures, or classes. Please check museum hours or call to ensure open hours prior to visiting or to schedule an appoinment. All pre-paid admissions tracked via order numbers. Multiple orders may be redeemed together for a group. ALL PRE-PAID ADMISSIONS EXPIRE 30 DAYS AFTER PURCHASE. Museum Hours: Wednesday, Thursday, Friday & Saturday 10 AM - 4 PM, Sunday Noon - 4
